steps.title: Load the quarter's filings
steps.prose: One row per filing from the bundled CSV: client, registrant, reported spend, and the filer's free-text account of what they lobbied on. Synthetic data shaped like a Senate LDA export; no real filing.
steps.data_description: Every filing in the sample, as the CSV records it.

steps.title: Keep the filings above $50,000
steps.prose: Drops filings under $50,000; exactly $50,000 is kept. The threshold is an editorial choice — check it is the line you would draw, because everything under it leaves here.
steps.data_description: Filings reporting at least $50,000; each drop is recorded.

steps.title: Read each filing's issue text
steps.prose: A model reads `specific_issues` and adds `policy_area`, `targets_specific_bill` and a one-sentence `primary_ask`. Check each against the issue text; it is the weakest link.
steps.data_description: The same filings, plus the model's three judgments.

steps.title: Flag what needs a second look
steps.prose: Flags a filing that named no bill or landed in catch-all Other — either way the text did not pin down the ask. Plain code, so a wrong flag traces to a wrong classification.

steps.title: Publish the triage report
steps.prose: One HTML page: spend, primary ask, issue text as filed, and for a flagged filing which condition flagged it. Check that reason against the text.
steps.data_description: One row per surviving filing, as published.
